categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet database migration code in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/sqlite.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents node crashes and potential wallet data loss during BDB-to-SQLite migration when database creation fails. As the PR notes, `MigrateToSQLite` previously aborted via `assert` and left behind an empty wallet file if SQLite creation failed on filesystems without locking support or out of space, violating basic migration safety.
